title: DCLab Code v1: a minimal developer app for ML work on the Claude Agent SDK, following R&D live
request: A developer tool like Codex and the Claude Code desktop app, with a new, simpler, more minimal UI and the same abilities, outside the R&D repository. Owner's choices: for ML developers, a new separate repository, a local web app first and a native macOS app later. Mid-build: the repository must follow R&D automatically (rules, leakage lists and tools read live, a check that fails when R&D changes them).
plan: Read the Agent SDK's real types (0.3.310) instead of relying on memory
Engine: the SDK's query() in streaming-input mode behind a small Node server
DCLab tools through R&D's MCP server, started by the app when it is down
Minimal UI: one conversation, a short session list grouped by state, changes on demand, a command palette, a status line with ML guards
Record every SDK message whole, append-only
Tests with a fake agent; live runs with a spend cap

decisions.decision: Use the Claude Agent SDK as the engine, not a new agent
decisions.why: It already has files, shell, search, subagents, sessions, permissions and MCP; rebuilding them would take months

decisions.decision: Plain Node http + Server-Sent Events + vanilla JS, one dependency
decisions.why: No build step, little to maintain, and a native app can use the same HTTP API later

decisions.decision: Token + local Host/Origin check on every API call
decisions.why: The agent can run shell commands; any web page could otherwise POST to localhost (and DNS rebinding could read it)

decisions.decision: Sealed/holdout guard through a PreToolUse hook returning 'ask', and never 'always allow'
decisions.why: canUseTool alone is not called for reads; DCLab's rule is that a sealed set or holdout is read once, on purpose

decisions.decision: Read R&D's rules and leakage list live from CLAUDE.md and SEALED_GLOBS; a lock file and npm run sync-check
decisions.why: Owner asked for the repository to follow R&D; copies drift

decisions.decision: Holdout-using DCLab calls listed in the app's config, checked against R&D's live tool list
decisions.why: R&D has no machine-readable flag for them; the check fails if R&D renames them
Found live: user settings pulled in every Claude Code plugin's MCP server (failed or needing sign-in), 56 tools instead of about 30

decisions.decision: Live text deltas are not recorded
decisions.why: The final assistant message holds the same text whole; the record keeps every other message whole

change: A new repository: a local Node server around the Agent SDK's query() (streaming input), a vanilla-JS page, append-only session records, sealed/holdout guards, a live link to R&D's rules, leakage list and MCP tools with a sync check.

findings.defect: A live event and its record had different timestamps
findings.scenario: Reopening a session while it streams could draw a note twice
findings.cause: Recorder and emit each called new Date()
findings.fix: Recorder.append returns its timestamp; the live event carries it
findings.test: tests/server.test.js: live note ts equals its record ts

findings.defect: Live permission cards had an empty summary
findings.scenario: A live question showed only the tool name
findings.cause: The live path built its own event instead of the replay mapping
findings.fix: Emit fromRecord(entry) for the live question too

findings.defect: Welcome text said DCLab tools were off after they started
findings.scenario: Opening the app while the MCP server starts
findings.cause: The welcome was drawn once, before the tool check finished
findings.fix: Redraw the welcome on every state change

findings.scenario: An MCP client that does not follow a 307 for POST would fail
findings.fix: Default URL with the trailing slash
findings.test: live: the SDK reported dclab connected

findings.defect: Plugin MCP servers loaded into every session
findings.scenario: Every start waited on Snowflake, Databricks, Amplitude… servers that failed or needed sign-in
findings.cause: settingSources includes user settings, which enable the plugins

findings.defect: Conversation squeezed to 320 px with the changes drawer open
findings.cause: Sidebar + drawer + main in one grid
findings.fix: Fold the sidebar under 1280 px while the drawer is open; labels never wrap

findings.defect: Changing only the URL hash did not open the session
One failed record write crashed the whole server
findings.scenario: Disk full or EACCES during a turn
findings.cause: handle() threw, note() threw again in catch, pump()'s promise was not awaited: unhandled rejection, exit 1
findings.fix: record() and setMeta() catch write errors and show one note; pump().catch logs
findings.test: server test: ENOSPC on sdk records, session and server go on

findings.defect: The idle close could end the agent during a background job
findings.scenario: A background training run outlives the turn; 20 minutes later close() ends the CLI
findings.cause: The idle clock started at each result and only send() cleared it
findings.fix: Any message restarts the clock; background_tasks_changed counted; never close while a job runs; work after a result shows as running
findings.test: server test: no close while a background task is listed

findings.defect: "Always allow" wrote permanent, sometimes broad rules
findings.scenario: CLI suggestions use destination localSettings; suppressAlwaysAllowRule ignored; setMode changed the mode silently
findings.fix: Every suggestion rewritten to destination session; no Always when suppressAlwaysAllowRule or no suggestion; a setMode suggestion updates the shown mode
findings.test: server test on destinations, the shown mode and the refused broad rule

findings.defect: The sealed guard missed folder-wide reads
findings.scenario: grep -rn x dclab_rnd/agent_eval, head dir/*.json, rg with no path, Grep with no path; R&D's make benchmark SPLIT=test and make decision-gate
findings.cause: The guard looked only at names in the step
findings.fix: Background scan of sealed folders per project (null = ask on every sweep); Bash sweeps that reach those folders ask; Grep gets an exclude glob; R&D's sealed-evaluation commands ask
findings.test: units: every review case asks, narrow steps do not; live: grep -rn over a folder with a fake sealed file asked

findings.defect: Opening a session could kill a live question
findings.scenario: A question arrives while the page loads a session; or two sessions opened quickly
findings.cause: Stale marking ran after replaying live events; any finished load cleared S.loading
findings.fix: Mark stale only from the record (skipping ones answered since), then replay; a load sequence number
findings.test: read; seen live with no regressions

findings.defect: The spending cap was per process, not per session
findings.scenario: Each idle close, crash or restart gave a fresh cap
findings.cause: maxBudgetUsd counts only since this query() started
findings.fix: Pass what is left of the session's cap; refuse to start when it is spent

findings.defect: A torn record line swallowed the next record
findings.scenario: Crash mid-write, then a new append on the same line
findings.fix: Before a session's first append in a process, add a newline if the file does not end with one
findings.test: units: torn line then two records, both read back

findings.defect: Any web page could frame the app
findings.scenario: A hidden frame trick-clicks Waiting on you, then Allow
findings.fix: X-Frame-Options DENY and a CSP with frame-ancestors none, scripts and styles only from self

findings.scenario: A new HOLDOUT_CALLS entry never reached an existing install
findings.fix: mergeGuards: saved lists add to the defaults

findings.defect: This SDK has no Grep tool
findings.scenario: The model asked for Grep and got: search with grep via Bash
findings.cause: SDK 0.3.310 tool list has no Grep or Glob
findings.fix: The Bash sweep guard carries the weight; the Grep rewrite stays for versions that have it
findings.test: live: init tool list read from the record

findings.defect: AskUserQuestion showed as a raw permission card
findings.scenario: The agent asks a multiple-choice question; Allow returned no answers
findings.cause: The host must collect answers and return them as updatedInput.answers
findings.fix: Question card with options, Other and Skip; /answers route; records question_request and question_answer
findings.test: server test; live: picked By time, the model received it

measurements.name: dclab-code test suite with a fake agent
measurements.gate: every test passes before the commit
limits: a fake agent: the SDK's real behaviour is checked only in the live runs

measurements.name: live runs on Haiku 5.5
measurements.gate: each live run stays under the 0.5 cap per session
limits: a throwaway project and fake sealed files only

outcome: dclab-code v1 runs locally, follows R&D live, records every step, and asks before any sealed or holdout read; pushed to a private repository.
lessons: Read the SDK's .d.ts first: the options (strictMcpConfig, maxBudgetUsd, hooks, toolUseID) were not all in memory
Guard by what a step touches, not by tool name: the model read the 'sealed' file with Bash, not Read
Test the UI at a laptop width with every panel open
Have an independent reviewer try to break the guards and the failure paths: it found 9 real problems the tests had not covered
Check a host-side assumption live, but only on fake data when the failure would leak a sealed set
risks: the SDK's tool list changes between versions (Grep was gone)
